WITH attorney_visa_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.counselmail,
        COUNT(*) as total_cases,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.visacls) as distinct_visa_types,
        MAX(CAST(cnt AS numeric) / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.counselmail)) as max_single_type_pct
    FROM case_attorney ca
    JOIN cases c ON ca.docketkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM case_attorney ca2
        JOIN cases c2 ON ca2.docketkey = c2.filekey
        WHERE ca2.counselmail = ca.counselmail AND c2.visacls = c.visacls

    LIMIT 5;
